text: In Prague in 1820, the poor student and swordsman Balduin longs for Countess Margit, and a gleeful old man in black named Scapinelli offers him 100,000 pieces of gold for any item in his lodgings. Balduin [signs the contract|trigger|saying yes to an offer], and Scapinelli calls his [reflection out of the mirror|images|mirrors and glass] and walks away with it. Rich now, Balduin courts Margit, but [his double keeps appearing in his place|threat|impostors and doubles], at a graveyard tryst and at a duel he swore not to win, until he [turns a pistol on it|ending|the protagonist dies].
